summary: Push A day. Breakfast stays pure grab-and-go (turkey, bagel, two hard-boiled eggs, blueberries) since he's been skipping it and favors eggs when he gets the choice. Lunch brings in Pollo Asado for variety after several days of saucy roasted-chicken mains. Today's wellness-bar protein smoothie (Banana Chai) covers pre-workout; dinner's Shoyu chicken plus extra chicken breast closes out protein for the day.
